welcomeLines:
Weddings, told the way your family will remember them.
From the heart of Bhaktapur, across the Kathmandu Valley and beyond.
quote: A wedding lasts a day. The way it felt should last a lifetime.

blocks.title: What we love
blocks.text: The nervous laugh before the tika. Aama’s tears at bidaai. The cousin who starts the dance nobody planned. We love the small, unrepeatable moments that make a Nepali wedding feel like home.

blocks.title: What we believe
blocks.text: That a wedding belongs to the family, not the camera. We know the rituals, we stay out of the way, and we never ask you to fake a moment. Honest pictures age beautifully.

blocks.title: What we do
blocks.text: Photographs, cinematic films and heirloom albums for weddings across Nepal, and commercial work for motorsport, travel and brands. One calm team, from the first mehendi to the last frame.
